               <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4575"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> ces <lb n="185a3"/>bya ba'i 'grel bshad 'thad pa'i 'od 'bar</rs> zhes bya ba | shes bya'i nam mkha' la blo gros kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas shing | legs smra'i 'od kyis phas rgol mun pa'i smag rum sel bar byed pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3884">shAkya'i dge slong rigs par <lb n="185a4"/>smra ba shes rab 'od zer</rs> gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so || × ||dag cing snyoms pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4576">shes rab 'bum</rs> gyis bris | dge'o || ||</seg></TEI>
